# Mobile client

## Goal
A small mobile client for Acme customers to browse the catalogue and place orders. It talks to the existing Acme API and never stores payment details.

## State
Idea raised by the CEO on 2026-11-17. Feasibility discussed in chat: the API already covers catalogue and orders. Engineering spike dispatched.

## Next step
Engineering runs the spike and leaves a handoff; then the CoS writes a decision card on whether and how to build the client.
